headline: Local Cricket Fan Successfully Retires From Supporting National Team After 48 Years of Unpaid 'Mental Coaching' Service
body: After nearly five decades of yelling tactical advice at his television screen, a resident of Indiranagar has formally submitted his resignation as a volunteer mental coach for the national squad, citing a well-deserved pension of zero rupees and a complete lack of a corporate health insurance plan.
caption: Finally decided to hang up his imaginary headset after 48 seasons of tactical brilliance from the comfort of his living room sofa. A true inspiration to all armchair experts. #CricketIndia #FanLife #Retirement (satire)
